chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
If there are two different calls then one (of them) must be towards misguidance.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when two calls diverge according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the principle of tawhid in guidance, asserting that simultaneous divergent calls to truth inevitably contain error. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that while truth is one, its manifestation in competing narratives often obscures the authentic path, requiring discernment (furqan) to distinguish the straight path from misguidance. The statement serves as a critical epistemological tool for evaluating religious and political claims in times of division.
